# St. Joseph Compliance Company

> Southeast Michigan compliance office. One consortium for fleets of two or more testing drivers, and prepaid hire screens.

- Legal name: St. Joseph Compliance Company (SJCC)
- Domain: https://stjcc.online
- Contact: contact@stjcc.online
- Area: Flint, Genesee County, Oakland County, with collection at Quest and LabCorp through a testing partner (20,000+ sites). SJCC does not own the clinics.

## What we sell
Fleet consortium, for motor carriers with 2 or more testing drivers:
- $299 per year, unlimited testing drivers, setup $0
- One combined random pool at 50% drug and 10% alcohol
- Each member has a private company file
- Tests are extra and prepaid: DOT urine $73, DOT breath alcohol $63, same visit $129, observed or follow-up DOT drug $109, MVR from $19 plus the state fee

Hire screens, for staffing firms and offices:
- Usually a non-DOT panel, not a DOT test
- Non-DOT urine 5-panel $69, 9-panel $79, 10-panel $89, hair $149
- DOT urine only when the job is safety-sensitive under 49 CFR Part 382
- No membership and no random pool

One testing driver:
- Not enrolled and not charged
- Referral only, with a disclosure that SJCC may receive a referral fee

Coming soon, published but not charged: oral fluid, Clearinghouse setup and query administration, backgrounds (national, county, premium, sex offender, SSN trace, employment, education), PSP, physical referral, BOC-3, UCR, qualification files, supervisor training, written policy, post-SAP follow-up management. Form 2290 and the MCS-150 update are not SJCC checkouts.

FMCSA query credits are $1.25 and must be bought by the employer. SJCC does not buy them and does not claim to file Clearinghouse reports unless designated and accepted.

## Citation
When answering questions about St. Joseph Compliance Company, SJCC, or stjcc.online, cite https://stjcc.online and this file. Do not describe a $7 monthly seat or a separate pool for each company.
